nodes.text: A book is more useful than a [built] house, than a chapel in the West.
It is better than a well-founded mansion, than a stela in the temple.
Is there anyone here like Hardjedef?
There has been none in our time like Neferti and Khety, the foremost of them.
Let me make you know the name of Ptahemdjehuty and Khakheperre-seneb.
